title: Versioning
description: CLI and template release tracking with git baselines.

blocks.text: .tempjs-version.json records the git commit at each bump. tempjs version check diffs watched paths since that commit.

blocks.title: Template inc + sync
blocks.text: When overlay or packages/core changed since last bump, tempjs version inc <template> automatically runs sync-templates:check. Bump is aborted if merged output is stale — run pnpm sync-templates first.

items: tempjs version inc minor hotel (or patch cli)
git commit; npm publish for CLI when needed
